name: Hallucinogenic Effects
description: Black Crusade, Table 5-1 (p. 151). Rolled when a target fails the Toughness Test against a Hallucinogenic weapon; a respirator or sealed armour grants +20 to that test. Effects last 1 round, plus 1 more per Degree of Failure. Note: the quality's text says to roll 1d100, but the table itself is numbered 1-9 and 0, so it is rolled on 1d10. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.name: Bugs
results.text: The character is Stunned for the duration.

results.name: My hands
results.text: The character drops everything he carries and is Stunned for the duration.

results.name: Coming through the walls
results.text: Each turn the character fires at a random piece of terrain in line of sight; use the scatter diagram to pick it, with 7 meaning the ground and 0 meaning wildly into the air. Anyone caught in the line of fire is attacked as normal.

results.name: Nobody can see me
results.text: Each round the character spends a Full Action wandering in a random direction (scatter diagram). He keeps his Reactions.

results.name: I can fly
results.text: The character may do nothing but jump on the spot. If above ground level, he may throw himself off in a random direction and take Falling Damage.

results.name: They've got it in for me
results.text: On his turn the character must move to cover, out of line of sight of all other characters, and stays hidden until the effect ends.

results.name: They got me
results.text: The character collapses and counts as helpless. Any character who sees him fall must pass an Intelligence Test or believe him dead.

results.name: I'll take you all on
results.text: The character enters a Frenzy and attacks the closest opponent.

results.name: I'm only little
results.text: All other characters count as having Fear (3) against the character.

results.name: The worms
results.text: The character attacks his own randomly determined leg with a held weapon, drawing one at random if unarmed. The attack hits automatically and deals normal Damage.
